$comment: MODE = light. Neutrals only: surfaces, text, borders, the decorative accent tint-surfaces (subtle) + their foregrounds, the hover shadow, and the focus ring. Brand/accent-bold colors come from the active theme via [data-theme]. Emitted under [data-mode='light'].

backdrop.comment: recessed mat behind the app frame / control tracks — a step below page

fill-hover.comment: a clear step darker than the resting fill

status.$comment: STATUS roles — success and danger. They live on the MODE axis, not the theme axis: what they mean is fixed (green is not a brand decision), but what reads on a page is not, so they carry a light and a dark value and every theme inherits both. `fill`/`on-fill` are the filled pair; `text` is the same status used AS TEXT, which needs its own step for the same reason text.accent does.

subtle.comment: the tint end of the pair — Badge subtle, Toast

danger.$comment: Danger splits by role. As a FILL it is solid red carrying a white label — the state a destructive control lands in on hover, and what a destructive surface is painted with. As TEXT (and the resting outline of a danger button) it is the same red, lifted to the palest step in dark mode so it holds AA on every dark surface.

fill.comment: solid danger red, carrying a white label at 6.27:1 — the same in both modes; a fill does not need to move

text.comment: danger AS TEXT — 4.97:1 on the page, 6.27:1 on card

on-bold.comment: ink reads on the light bold hues

on-subtle.comment: ink reads on the pale subtle tints

lift.comment: a card's hover — the halo, the same size and spread as dark's glow

button-lift.comment: buttons cast no shadow on hover — nothing raises

float.comment: the shadow a surface holds at REST because it is already raised — a dialog, a toast, a slider thumb. Distinct from `lift`, which is the hover response of a card.
